India to Consider Social Media Ban for Children Under 16

The Indian government is considering a ban on social media use by children under the age of 16, with consultations taking place ahead of the monsoon session. The proposed rule change aims to protect young users from potential online harm. The move has sparked debate about the role of social media in children's lives and its impact on their well-being.
